title: Dungeon World Moves (summarised)
attribution: Dungeon World by Sage LaTorra and Adam Koebel, CC BY 3.0. Summarised and reworded by Project Logos; not the original text.

moves.name: Hack and Slash
moves.description: Attack an enemy in close combat.

outcomes.strong: You hit and deal your damage. You may also press the attack for extra damage, at the price of leaving yourself open to a counterblow.
outcomes.weak: You hit and deal your damage, but the enemy hits back or you end up in a bad position.
outcomes.miss: The attack fails and the GM makes a move against you.

moves.name: Volley
moves.description: Attack an enemy from a distance with a thrown or fired weapon.

outcomes.strong: A clean shot: you hit and deal your damage.
outcomes.weak: You hit, but you also pick a cost: step into danger, settle for a worse shot, or spend extra ammunition.
outcomes.miss: The shot goes wide or does no good, and the GM makes a move against you.

moves.name: Defy Danger
moves.description: Act despite a looming danger. The stat depends on how you face it: strength, agility, toughness, wits, insight or charm.

outcomes.strong: You do it, and the danger does not touch you.
outcomes.weak: You do it, but the GM offers a worse outcome, hard bargain, or ugly choice.
outcomes.miss: The danger lands. The GM makes a move against you and things get worse.

moves.name: Defend
moves.description: Guard a person, place or thing against an incoming threat.

outcomes.strong: You hold the line and earn several benefits from the GM's list, such as redirecting the attack, taking the hit yourself, or gaining an opening.
outcomes.weak: You hold, but earn only a small benefit, and the threat still costs you.
outcomes.miss: Your guard breaks. What you were protecting is exposed and the GM makes a move.

moves.name: Spout Lore
moves.description: Call on what you know about a creature, place, legend or object.

outcomes.strong: The GM tells you something useful and interesting about the subject, and how it bears on your situation.
outcomes.weak: The GM tells you something interesting; whether it is useful is for you to work out.
outcomes.miss: Your memory fails or misleads you, and the GM makes a move.

moves.name: Discern Realities
moves.description: Study a scene or a person closely to see what is really going on.

outcomes.strong: You may ask the GM several honest questions about the scene and use the answers.
outcomes.weak: You may ask the GM one honest question about the scene.
outcomes.miss: You notice little, and the GM makes a move.

moves.name: Parley
moves.description: Use leverage, a promise or a threat to talk someone into doing what you want.

outcomes.strong: They do what you ask, in return for what you promised or threatened.
outcomes.weak: They will do it, but only after you give proof, a deposit, or a firm guarantee.
outcomes.miss: Talk fails, the GM makes a move, and the other side may turn hostile.

moves.name: Aid or Interfere
moves.description: Help or hinder another character who is acting. This table plays without bonds, so the roll has no stat bonus.

outcomes.strong: Your help lands: they get a bonus on their roll (or a penalty, if you interfered).
outcomes.weak: Your help lands, but you share the danger or cost of their action.
outcomes.miss: You get in the way or stumble, and the GM makes a move against you.

moves.name: Last Breath
moves.description: When a character drops to zero HP, they glimpse death and roll to see what happens next. No stat applies.

outcomes.strong: You cheat death and stabilise at 1 HP.
outcomes.weak: Death offers a bargain; take it and stabilise, or refuse and pass.

gm_moves.name: Show Signs of an Approaching Threat
gm_moves.description: Hint that something dangerous is coming before it arrives.

gm_moves.name: Deal Damage
gm_moves.description: Hurt a character, with the amount set by the source of the harm.

gm_moves.name: Use Up Their Resources
gm_moves.description: Drain ammunition, supplies, light or something else the party is relying on.

gm_moves.name: Turn Their Move Back on Them
gm_moves.description: Take what the character just did or tried and reflect it against them.

gm_moves.name: Separate Them
gm_moves.description: Split the party apart, by distance, barrier or circumstance.

gm_moves.name: Give an Opportunity
gm_moves.description: Offer a chance that fits a character's strengths, nature or goals.

gm_moves.name: Show a Downside to Their Class or Race
gm_moves.description: Let a character's strengths or traits work against them in this moment.

gm_moves.name: Offer an Opportunity with a Cost
gm_moves.description: Present something the party wants, at a price they must decide whether to pay.

gm_moves.name: Tell Them the Requirements or Consequences
gm_moves.description: Lay out what it would take, or what will follow, then ask what they do.

gm_moves.name: Reveal an Unwelcome Truth
gm_moves.description: Surface a hidden fact that complicates matters.

gm_moves.name: Use a Location or Environment Move
gm_moves.description: Let the place itself act: collapse, flood, darkness, sound or a trap.

gm_moves.name: Put Someone in a Spot
gm_moves.description: Place a character in immediate danger or a hard choice, and make them act.

pregens.name: Bronwen Ashgrove
pregens.look: Broad-shouldered, scarred knuckles, a dented shield painted with a faded sun.

pregens.name: Pip Quillfeather
pregens.look: Wiry and quick-eyed, wrapped in a patched grey cloak with too many pockets.

pregens.name: Brother Tamsin Reed
pregens.look: Soft-spoken and weathered, with a lantern-shaped holy symbol and ink-stained fingers.

pregens.name: Isolde Marrowmere
pregens.look: Tall and pale, singed sleeves, a crooked staff hung with small brass charms.
